I found 17 problems. 16 are clear WCAG 2.2 AA failures and one is borderline (#16). I checked them in the browser: the accessibility tree, measured colour contrast, keyboard use, a 320px-wide window, and extra text spacing. No files were changed. | # | Problem | Rule it breaks | |---|---|---| | 1 | The `` tag has no `lang` attribute. | 3.1.1 Language of Page (A) | | 2 | Text contrast is too low. White on #00BBFF is 2.2:1 for almost all text, so even large headings fail 3:1. Grey box: 1.14:1. Links: 4.27:1. "Submit": 4.0:1. | 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA) | | 3 | `important-chart.jpg` has no `alt` text, so the chart has no text alternative. | 1.1.1 Non-text Content (A) | | 4 | The decorative image has a long description instead of `alt=""`. | 1.1.1 (F39) | | 5 | The Name, Email and Message labels are plain `

` text, not linked to their fields. The Email field has no accessible name at all. | 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A); 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A) | | 6 | The Phone label is hidden (`display:none`), so only placeholder text shows, and the field sits under "Email:". | 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (A) | | 7 | The name, email and phone fields have no `autocomplete` values. | 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose (AA) | | 8 | The links say only "click here" and "read more", which don't say where they go. | 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) (A) | | 9 | The table's header row uses `` instead of ``. | 1.3.1 (F91) | | 10 | Headings go h3 → h1 → h2. | 1.3.1 (often treated as best practice) | | 11 | The "URGENT" text blinks forever with no way to stop it. | 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide (A) | | 12 | The video autoplays on a loop, isn't muted, and has no controls. Its file returns 404 (not found), so the problem only shows once the file is fixed. | 2.2.2 (A); 1.4.2 Audio Control (A) | | 13 | The video has no captions or audio description (needed if it shows real content). | 1.2.2 (A); 1.2.3 (A); 1.2.5 (AA) | | 14 | The country picker is built as a menu, not a selection list. The chosen country is never shown on screen or exposed to screen readers. | 4.1.2 (A) | | 15 | After you pick a country, keyboard focus is lost (it jumps to the page itself). | 2.4.3 Focus Order (A) | | 16 | Input borders and backgrounds are 2.07:1 and 2.2:1 against the page. Borderline: these are the browser's default styles. | 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA) | | 17 | The country options are 18px tall and touch each other. | 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA) | **Not failures, but worth knowing** - There's no `

` or other page regions, and the skip link jumps to a wrapper around everything, so it skips nothing. - Some of the page's own labels are wrong: - WCAG has no minimum font size, so the 8px text only fails on contrast. - The blink is once a second, below the seizure limit (3 flashes a second, rule 2.3.1). - The blue box that claims "poor focus management" passed my tests. - The fake `
` buttons work by keyboard, but real `
